title: Afternoon Escape Wine Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Relax and let us guide you through the breathtaking scenery of our wine country while you learn about and visit 3 unique wineries. Guests will start their day with a tour/tasting at Grand Pre Wines, the oldest farm winery in Atlantic Canada build on love and passion for Nova Scotia. Enjoy a curated cheese tasting from Le Caveau, an international and nationally recognized culinary destination. Afterward enjoy two more winery stops for guided tasting at each. Wineries are subject to change.
